# **tests**

Unit tests validating VertexStep, EdgeStep, RepeatStep, ShortestPathStep against stepRegistry integration, toJSON/fromJSON serialization, and clone() semantics.

## Contents

- [traversal.steps.test.ts](./traversal.steps.test.ts) — Tests stepRegistry registration, [stepName, config] JSON tuple serialization, round-trip preservation of direction/weightProperty/targetId/edgeLabels, and partial clone() overrides for traversal step classes.

## File Relationships

- Imports step classes (VertexStep, EdgeStep, RepeatStep, ShortestPathStep) from [../index.js](../index.js)
- Imports stepRegistry from [../../StepRegistry.js](../../StepRegistry.js)

## Behavioral Contracts

- **JSON Serialization**: toJSON() returns [stepName, config] tuple; fromJSON(["Vertex",{direction:"out",edgeLabels:["knows"]}]) deserializes preserving properties; fromJSON(null) and fromJSON(["WrongName",{}]) return null; round-trip preserves direction="both", weightProperty="cost", targetId="Person:target", edgeLabels=["knows","likes"]
- **Registry Integration**: stepRegistry.has("Vertex"|"Edge"|"Repeat"|"ShortestPath") returns true; stepRegistry.get(name).category equals "traversal"; Traversal category step list contains ["Vertex","Edge","Repeat","ShortestPath"]; stepRegistry.create("Vertex",{direction:"out",edgeLabels:[]}) produces VertexStep instance; stepRegistry.create("ShortestPath",{targetId:"X:1"}) produces ShortestPathStep instance
- **Cloning Semantics**: step.clone({direction:"in"}) overrides direction preserving edgeLabels=["knows"], stepLabels=["a"]; repeatStep.clone({times:5}) overrides times from 2→5 preserving steps.length=1; supports generic type parameter RepeatStep<readonly Step<any>[]>
- **Static Properties**: VertexStep.stepName equals "Vertex", category equals "traversal"; EdgeStep.stepName equals "Edge", category equals "traversal"; RepeatStep.stepName equals "Repeat", category equals "traversal"; ShortestPathStep.stepName equals "ShortestPath", category equals "traversal"
- **Configuration Types**: VertexStep config accepts {direction:"out"|"in"|"both", edgeLabels:string[], stepLabels?:string[]}; EdgeStep config accepts {direction, edgeLabels}; RepeatStep config accepts {times:number, emit?:boolean}, steps:Step[] nested array; ShortestPathStep config accepts {targetId:ElementId, direction, maxDepth?:number, edgeLabels?:string[], weightProperty?:string, stepLabels?:string[]}
